question: What completion boundary can be delivered before workspace/module navigation?
decision: Add bounded single-document completion using shared DeclarationIndex records, resolved signatures, UTF-16 positions, prefix replacement text edits, a language keyword queue that remains available while parsing is incomplete, and a dot trigger for automatic member and namespace completion.

query.position_encoding: UTF-16 code units mapped to source-local bytes
query.filter: ASCII identifier prefix immediately before the position
query.incomplete_document: keyword-only prefix completion remains available when no AST can be produced

quantitative_gate: tests/lsp_tests.py covers the dot trigger, function-prefix filtering, incomplete-document keyword completion, print keyword completion, signature detail, and replacement range.
out_of_scope: context-aware keyword filtering and native library names
